create_sine_regression_loss: create an ML3_SineRegressionLoss module with configurable input and hidden dimensions for sine regression tasks
create_mountain_car_loss: create an Ml3_loss_mountain_car learnable loss network with ELU activations for mountain car tasks
create_reacher_loss: create an Ml3_loss_reacher learnable loss network with input normalization for reacher tasks
create_shaped_sine_loss: create an Ml3_loss_shaped_sine learnable loss network with default 3 input and 1 output dimensions
reset_sine_regression_weights: reset the weights of an ML3_SineRegressionLoss module using xavier uniform initialization
